outcome: Rate of HIV detection in pregnant women
cohort: Pregnant women in Ceará, Brazil diagnosed with HIV between 2017 and 2021.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a decrease in the rate of HIV detection and an increase in the likelihood of women not using antiretrovirals during delivery.
mod_finding: There was a reduction in both vaginal and caesarean deliveries among women diagnosed with HIV after the start of the pandemic.
